question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias for this release line, and should it include only the inbound-shaped helpers in this PR or the full pre-removal helper-name set?
rationale: This is a public PluginRuntime API compatibility decision: the code fix is narrow, but accepting or limiting the deprecated alias changes the supported third-party plugin contract.

options.title: Accept Scoped Alias
options.body: Resolve the branch conflict and land the object-identical alias for the inbound-shaped helpers reported by affected plugins, keeping `inbound` canonical for new code.

options.title: Expand Legacy Scope First
options.body: Before merge, add or explicitly document the older `turn` helper names such as `runPrepared`, `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, and `dispatchAssembled`.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide old third-party channel plugins must republish against `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding the runtime API.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Alias
recommendation.body: Resolve the branch conflict and land the object-identical alias for the inbound-shaped helpers reported by affected plugins, keeping `inbound` canonical for new code.

likelyOwner.reason: The alias removal traces to steipete's commit, so this is the best available owner for the compatibility-contract decision.
